const assert=require('assert');
(async()=>{const root='http://127.0.0.1:3000',get=()=>fetch(root+'/api/workbooks/ops-plan').then(r=>r.json());let a=await get(),b=structuredClone(a);a.workbook.sheets[0].cells.F2='alpha';let save=async x=>fetch(root+'/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(x)});let r=await save({baseRevision:1,workbook:a.workbook,userId:'riley'});assert.equal(r.status,200);b.workbook.sheets[0].cells.G2='beta';r=await save({baseRevision:1,workbook:b.workbook,userId:'morgan'});assert.equal(r.status,200);let merged=await r.json();assert.equal(merged.workbook.sheets[0].cells.F2,'alpha');assert.equal(merged.workbook.sheets[0].cells.G2,'beta');let c=await get(),d=structuredClone(c);c.workbook.sheets[0].cells.H2='first';d.workbook.sheets[0].cells.H2='second';assert.equal((await save({baseRevision:c.revision,workbook:c.workbook,userId:'priya'})).status,200);r=await save({baseRevision:d.revision,workbook:d.workbook,userId:'morgan'});assert.equal(r.status,409);let before=(await get()).revision;assert.equal((await save({baseRevision:before,workbook:{id:'ops-plan'},userId:'riley'})).status,400);assert.equal((await get()).revision,before);let renamed=(await get()).workbook;renamed.title='Bad';assert.equal((await save({baseRevision:before,workbook:renamed,userId:'riley'})).status,400);console.log('All API tests passed, revision',before)})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})
